# Front Desk & Cashier Phone Inquiry Log
Store Location: Apex Hardware #104, Lakewood, OH

## Shift Information
| Date | Cashier Name | Register Station | Shift Hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 03/14/2026 | Derek Alvarez | Register 2 (Customer Service) | 08:00 AM - 04:30 PM |

## Call Record
- Time of Call: 10:18 AM
- Caller Name: Marcus Vance
- Caller Phone: (216) 555-0184
- Inquiry Type: Item hold and price verification

## Item Details & Inventory Check
| SKU | Item Description | In-Stock Qty | Unit Price | Aisle Location |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 448-9102 | 12-Gauge Contractor Extension Cord 50ft | 7 | $39.99 | Aisle 4B |
| 812-3041 | 20V Lithium-Ion Drill Kit | 2 | $129.00 | Aisle 7A |

## Action Taken
- Located 1 unit of SKU 448-9102 on Aisle 4B for the caller.
- Placed the extension cord in the Customer Service will-call cubby labeled Vance.
- Verified that SKU 812-3041 remains available with 2 units on shelf.
- Notified caller that the extension cord unit price is $59.99 before tax.
- Advised caller of our standard 24-hour hold duration policy.

## Caller Message & Hand-off Note
- Customer plans to pick up the extension cord around 02:00 PM today.
- If you actually bothered to read our weekly sales flyer, you would know drills are excluded from current coupons.
- Please pass this log to Head Cashier Shannon Miller before the afternoon rush.
